scope: Frozen bed-centre threshold stress; synthetic contact geometry, no raw IMU inference

protocol.spread_basis: Generator truth before perturbation; observed spans are stored separately
protocol.false_positive_model: Extra event outside the true padded bed footprint
protocol.decoder: Union over all potentially erroneous-event choices; never truth-selected
protocol.statistical_unit: 14 independent development geometries; directions, visits and seeds are repeated stress conditions

interpretation: Output share means radius <=0.5m, distinct from actual point accuracy
Stress directions and synthetic false events do not estimate real-world error probabilities
The one-bad-event bound is an assumption, not a validated action-recognition error rate
Event redundancy means repeated visits, not overlapping windows from the same interaction
